name: Quessa
hail: We have heard the Hum for a long time. Now we answer, softly.
Hum, we listened before we spoke. This is Quessa, from below the ground.
Softly, from the deep galleries. We have listened long enough to answer.
close: We go back to listening. Quessa.
The ground remembers. Speak softly, and we will hear.
finding: We listened a long while. This is what it said: {part}
{part} We let it echo until it rang true.
Hear this as we heard it: {part}
{part} We listened twice before we spoke.
sighting: We were listening when this came: {part}
A sound in the sky, as we heard it: {part}
{part} We hold still, and keep listening.
{part} The arrays heard it, and so we tell you.
archive: The ground remembers. Here is some of what it holds: {part}
{part} We kept it deep, where it stays cool.
From the galleries, carried up for you: {part}
Listen to what we have kept: {part}
{part} Hear it as many times as you need.
culture: {part} That is how Quessa sounds, from inside.
We are a people of the ground. {part}
We hear through our feet, and we map by echo. {part}
request: We have listened. Now we ask: {part}
{part} We will be listening for your answer.
{part} Answer softly, and we will hear.
Let your world speak to us: {part}
verdict: We listened to all of it. {part}
{part} The ground remembers what we decide.
accord: On what is between us, softly: {part}
We listened to every word before this: {part}
Hear this clearly, though we say it softly: {part}
